scope: Independent neutral-form G0 critique; no geometry or production writes

axes.evidence: Eight distinct broad slabs; softly uneven front edges; clearly built tread sequence in front and three_quarter.
Separate base, carrier blocks and crowns visibly replace R2 homogeneous wedges. Side still presents a continuous triangular envelope with mostly vertical divisions, little stone bonding.
Both foot pillars unmistakably show broad foot, compact shaft and projecting cap; pedestal_detail confirms connected anatomy.
Wide landing and two upper terminating bodies resolve the run; upper_detail shows continuous destination and closed sides.
No real slope donor/context supplied; isolated asset cannot prove terrain embedment.

Quiet chunky cartoon proportions and restrained asymmetry, but long near-identical crown plates, regular vertical wall sections and uniform bevel bands retain a manufactured/CAD character. Front crown sequence is notably repetitive.
Eight steps visually countable and source isolations reviewed; actual 3H, collisions and walkability are tester responsibility and have not been independently signed off by this critic.

threshold: mean >=8; no score <6; untested axes excluded, never assigned invented scores
repair_recommendation: One bounded geometry pass on the wall/crown family: make a small number of deliberately different large stone groupings with legible staggered bearing joints and varied crown lengths/end contours, preserving existing tread and pillar anatomy. Do not try to cure the remaining CAD rhythm through material/noise.
